primary_metric: Macro mean V/U/R over the 12 test cases after averaging seeds; paired bootstrap on all three metrics versus the official baseline at prefixes 4/8/13/16.
paired_conditions: Every method runs on the same 12 cases, same repeat seeds [17, 42], same 16-call budget per case-seed, same local model and sampling (qwen2.5:3b-instruct-q4_K_M, temperature 0.7), and is scored by the same official evaluator. The only difference between methods is the generation procedure (prompt face and deterministic assembly); no method sees ground truths at generation time, and the official baseline is the upstream prompt loop with history, unmodified.
selection: Cases sampled deterministically (seeds 31415 dev / 27182 test, dev excluded) and stratified across n_observations 2 and 3 from the official collection generated at seed 2026 (full operators, depth 2); no result-based filtering.
